previous_audits.verdict_rationale: The distinct-support enumeration is a genuine class-C finite computation, but its result does not establish the advertised full mixed-cumulant coefficient. For N1-N2, the distinct-support balance scan and tree leaf-peeling leave the separate repeated, leafless-support route untested, so their two mechanisms do not close the same residual. For N3-N5, the note's boundary and canonical language is mostly scope hygiene rather than a hidden premise, no prior residual witness is cited, and the negative vanishing statements lack live checks across the required five resolution classes. For N6-N8, the indexed premises, partial closures, and cross-cycle echoes do not repair this internal enumeration gap, while the strongest N7 steelman—exhaustion after leaf peeling—remains unresolved by the supplied runner.
